headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Public Trend Signals
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis and security checks to improve ClearInstall’s risk assessment capabilities, ensuring safer local-first installations. Leverage community-driven tools for enhanced binding.gyp command handling and package integrity verification.
actions: Integrate Marvisak/VIctory's real-time dependency analysis features to provide up-to-date security insights during the install process.
Adopt erkamyaman/rust-anything’s advanced binding.gyp command expansion techniques for more accurate and secure handling of native modules.
